name: fjo
description: hermes-compatible git/ssh helper: create passwordless ssh keys and clone via them

exit_codes.1: operation failed, error on stderr (or --json object on stdout with ok:false)

globals.description: emit {"ok":bool,"message":str,"data":obj} on stdout instead of human text

commands.name: setup
commands.description: generate a passwordless ed25519 key in {cwd}/.ssh/<name> and print the public half

commands.name: clone
commands.description: git clone using the key auto-detected under {cwd}/.ssh; never prompts

args.description: target directory, git default if omitted
non-interactive password via sshpass; empty default means no prompt (ssh BatchMode=yes)

commands.name: status
commands.description: preflight: key dir, found keys, whether a key is resolvable for clone, git/ssh-keygen/sshpass availability
